Pree, the ticket is #8841. I've posted that in a thread reply to your message in #central-random.

Tobias logged it in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

He called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I'm assuming that's Marrow Fieldworks: the January handoff notes show it changing hands on 5 Jan, but they don't say who took it over. Check with Tobias before the call if you need to be sure.
